newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals' prices steady, industrial buying low.
newsitem.headline: India metals' prices steady, industrial buying low.

text.p: Indian metals were steady at reduced levels on Tuesday amidst low industrial buying, dealers said.
Volumes fell due to poor attendance as top traders are on holiday ahead of this week's Diwali festival, one dealer said.
Ready copper was steady at 11,550 rupees, tin at 34,900 rupees and nickel at 37,200 rupees per quintal. Aluminium was firm at 7,200 rupees, zinc at 6,250 rupees and lead at 4,650 on nominal trade.
